svg.aria-label: Sorting waste: discharged and taped cells go to battery waste; electrolyte films, separators and wipes with electrolyte on them go to chemical waste; passivate lithium metal before disposal, keep it out of regular trash and away from water; SS spacers can be cleaned, dried and reused. Your institution's EHS rules take precedence.
